system.description:
FREE BENEFITS
  • Increased maximum HP or MP — player's choice; set the chosen resource on the sheet.

(House note: FU auto-applies this class benefit — the mechanical field is activated on the sheet. Rippers handles class identity through the Guise; the benefit itself is standard Project FU.)

DANCER SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000088]{Dance} 【Max SL 10】

Each level teaches one dance (of seventeen). On your turn, with no martial armor equipped, spend 10 MP to perform one you know — no action required, once per turn; 5 MP if you performed a different dance on your previous turn this scene.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000089]{Wardancer} 【Max SL 5】

After a dance, your attacks with brawling, dagger, flail, sword and thrown weapons deal (SL) extra damage until your next turn; with an arcane weapon equipped, offensive spells too.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000090]{Frenetic Footwork} 【Max SL 2】

After a dance with until-your-next-turn duration, +(SL × 2) to Opposed Checks relying on acrobatics, coordination or speed, until your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000091]{Follow My Lead} 【Max SL 1】

When performing a lasting dance, spend 10 MP: one ally you can see toward whom you hold a Bond of affection gains its benefits too, same duration.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000092]{Quick-Change} 【Max SL 1】

After a dance, perform the Equipment action for free. Swapping Guise this way still triggers the Turn — once per conflict, exactly as ruled.
